summary: Yutaka Takagi specialized in history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and Japanology. He studied at Tokyo University of Literature and Science (~1948–1951) and served as a professor at Rissho University (~1974–1999).

Yutaka Yoshida is a scholar of Iranian and Central Asian studies and linguistics. He studied at Hitotsubashi University and the University of Tokyo (~1977–1981), and held posts at Hitotsubashi University and Kyoto University (~2006–2020).
Yutaka Yuda specialized in Indology and philosophy. He studied at the University of Tokyo (~1951–1955) and served as a professor at Kanagawa University (~1976–2002).

Yuto Kawamura works in Indology and linguistics. He was a postdoctoral fellow at Kyoto University (2015–2018) and held posts at Hiroshima University (attested 2013–2020) and the University of Oxford (attested 2019).

Yuzo Mizoguchi specialized in Sinology and philosophy. He studied at Kyushu University, the University of Tokyo (~1954–1958), and Nagoya University (~1958–1961), and held posts at Saitama University (~1967–1978), the University of Tokyo (~1978–1993), and Daito Bunka University (~1993–2003).

Zarawar Khan specializes in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. He earned an MA and PhD in archaeology at the University of Peshawar and served as Assistant Professor of Archaeology at the University of Swat (attested 2019–2022).

Zeff Bjerken works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and religious studies. He studied at UC Santa Barbara and the University of Michigan (PhD, 2001) under Donald S. Lopez Jr., and held a post at the College of Charleston (attested 2001).

Zeng Yang works in Buddhist studies and Sinology. Yang was a research student under Toshinori Ochiai at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and earned a PhD at the University of British Columbia under Jinhua Chen (attested 2018).
Zenno Ikuno specialized in Indology and Buddhist studies. He completed an MA at the University of Tokyo and held a post at Asia University (attested 1982).

Zenno Ishigami worked in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at Taisho University (~1949–1953), where he later served as professor (~1976–2000), and was a researcher at the Sanko Research Institute (attested 2008).

Zenryu Tsukamoto worked in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He studied at Bukkyo University (~1917–1921) and Kyoto University (~1923–1926) under Shinko Mochizuki. His posts included the Academy of Oriental Culture, Kyoto University (attested 1956–1966), Kacho Junior College, and Bukkyo University.
Zesei Machida was a Buddhist studies scholar who held posts at Kuon-ji (attested 1990) and Minobusan University, where he was an honorary professor (attested 1996–2001).
Zhao Luo specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Sinology. He studied under Sen Wang and held a scholar post at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (attested 2014).
Zhaohua Yang works in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He held posts at Stanford University (attested 2007) and Columbia University (attested 2018).

Zhe Ji works in religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Sinology. He earned a PhD in sociology from the École des hautes études en sciences sociales (-2007) and served as an Associate Professor at INALCO (attested 2011–2017).
Zhen Liu specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. Liu earned master's degrees from the Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (-2005) and Lanzhou University (-2009).
Zhenhua was a Buddhist studies figure who studied at Tianning Buddhist College (1947) and under Yin Shun (1952). He later served as manager at Fuyan Buddhist Institute (attested 1992).

Zhihua Yao specializes in philosophy and Buddhist studies. He earned a PhD at Boston University (~1998–2002) under Malcolm David Eckel and held posts at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (~2003) and the University of Hong Kong (2005).

Zhiru Ng specializes in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Sinology. She earned an MA at the University of Michigan under Luis Oscar Gómez and a PhD at the University of Arizona under Robert M. Gimello, later serving at Pomona College.

Zhiyi Yang specializes in Sinology. She studied at Peking University, the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg, and Princeton University (PhD) under Martin Kern, and held posts at the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg and Goethe University Frankfurt (attested 2015).
